newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb says to reconsider poison pill.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb says to reconsider poison pill.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb Inc said on Monday that its board will consider a proposal to revoke or conduct a shareholder vote on the company's "poison pill" plan.
The announcement followed the company's annual meeting, held in San Antonio, during which shareholders voted in favor of the proposal.
The recommendation is non-binding, and will be considered by the board of directors at a forthcoming board meeting, the company said.
Earlier this month, the company detailed "a major restructuring plan that is expected to result in annual savings of more than $100 million in 1999.

"The restructuring program is a significant part of our strategy for growth that will deliver consistent earnings to shareholders and leading edge products to consumers," chief executive officer William Carpenter said at the meeting.
Bausch & Lomb is a global eye care company headquartered in Rochester, N.Y., with annual revenues of about $2 billion, the company said.
